title: The portfolio is two things
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The application wants a portfolio. Wood lays out everything he's made. Two things survive his own eye: the crab and the estuary. The digests don't count. He says so.

panels.composition: The bedroom floor covered: digests, Timberline pages, the Spring Special, loose strips. WOOD standing in the middle of it.

image.prompt: a young man standing in a bedroom with the floor covered in photocopied comic strips and newspaper pages, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood picking up sheets and putting them down. A stack growing by the door: rejected.

image.prompt: a young man sorting sheets of paper on a bedroom floor, a discarded stack growing by the door, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Two sheets on the bed: the crab flyer's original, the estuary. Nothing else.

image.prompt: close on two drawings laid on a bed: a hatched crab and a wide estuary at low tide, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood, to the digests on the floor.

balloons.text: You don't count. You're the thing I do. They want the thing I make.

image.prompt: a young man looking down at a floor of photocopied comic booklets, talking to them, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Two drawings. 'You're the thing I do.' Chloe will say it back in Oct 2000.
